nodes.description: Instance of the DraGONS NFT contract (0xF7f83CbB51BA65FB19AB9ED6ca9520E637b6f192) used to verify the minter owns at least one DraGON.
mapping(address => uint256) public lastKimera storing the last mint timestamp per address, used as the 10 day cooldown timer.
uint constant public MAX_KIMERAS = 5000, the immutable upper bound of the Alien Kimera supply.
uint256 public constant kimeraPrice = 60e18, the amount of AMBER that is burned per mint.
address private dragonsContract holding the hard-coded address of the DraGONS NFT contract.
bool public AkpIsActive toggle that gates whether the Alien Kimera mint is open.
uint256 public maxKimeras, mutable supply cap checked in AKProtocol (initialised to MAX_KIMERAS).
string private baseURI, metadata prefix returned by the overridden _baseURI().
AmberToken public amberToken, ERC20 used for the balance check and for burning the mint price.
AlienKimeraProtocol constructor: sets ERC721 name/symbol, RandomlyAssigned(MAX_KIMERAS,0), maxKimeras and the dragons instance.
onlyOwner function that points the amberToken state variable at a new AmberToken address.
internal view override returning the stored baseURI used to build token metadata URIs.
onlyOwner function that updates the baseURI metadata prefix.
onlyOwner function that toggles the AkpIsActive mint gate.
Public mint entry point: checks active flag, supply, DraGON balance, AMBER balance and 10 day cooldown, then mints via nextToken/_safeMint and burns AMBER.
External view returning lastKimera[user], the last mint timestamp for the queried address.
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken() override that derives a pseudo-random token index from block/environment values and updates the token matrix.
Caller supplied address, used as the minter, as cooldown key and as randomness entropy.
Miner-controllable block timestamp used both as the cooldown clock and as entropy for random token assignment.
Pseudo-random index computed as keccak256(msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit, block.timestamp) % maxIndex (timestamp/block dependency).
External call amberToken.burn(msg.sender, kimeraPrice) executed after the NFT has already been minted.
_safeMint(msg.sender, mintIndex) which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient, handing control to an attacker contract.
address parameter of setAmberToken, the new AmberToken contract address.
string parameter of setBaseURI, the new metadata base URI.
address parameter of getLastKimera, the account whose last mint time is queried.
Local variable in AKProtocol holding dragons.balanceOf(msg.sender).
Local variable in AKProtocol holding amberToken.balanceOf(msg.sender).
Local variable in AKProtocol assigned block.timestamp, the current mint time.
Local variable in AKProtocol assigned lastKimera[msg.sender], the previous mint timestamp.
Local variable in AKProtocol holding the token id returned by nextToken().

edges.reason: Constructor writes the initial maxKimeras value.
Constructor initialises the dragons DraGONS instance.
Constructor reads dragonsContract to instantiate the DraGONS interface.
Constructor forwards MAX_KIMERAS to RandomlyAssigned.
setAmberToken assigns the amberToken state variable.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
flipAkpState toggles the AkpIsActive flag.
getLastKimera reads lastKimera for the requested user.
AKProtocol requires AkpIsActive to be true.
AKProtocol checks totalSupply against maxKimeras.
AKProtocol compares the AMBER balance against kimeraPrice.
AKProtocol queries dragons.balanceOf(msg.sender).
AKProtocol queries and later burns via amberToken.
AKProtocol reads and finally writes lastKimera[msg.sender].
AKProtocol calls nextToken() to obtain the mint id.
msg.sender determines the minter identity and cooldown key in AKProtocol.
block.timestamp is read in AKProtocol as the current mint time for the cooldown check.
AKProtocol indirectly triggers nextToken(), which computes the mint index from block.timestamp and other block values (timestamp dependency).
AKProtocol performs the external amberToken.burn call after minting.
AKProtocol calls _safeMint, which performs an external callback to the recipient.
msg.sender is packed into the randomness preimage used by nextToken.
block.timestamp is used as entropy for the pseudo-random token index (timestamp dependency).
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of amberToken.burn.
msg.sender is the _to recipient of _safeMint and thus the callback target.
_safeMint calls onERC721Received on the caller-controlled contract, which can re-enter AKProtocol before lastKimera[msg.sender] is updated, bypassing the cooldown and minting extra tokens.
block.timestamp is stored into the local time variable.
The local time value is written back into lastKimera[msg.sender] at the end of AKProtocol.
lastKimera[msg.sender] is loaded into the local timerUser variable for the cooldown check.
The _amber parameter is the input address used by setAmberToken.
The uri parameter is the input string used by setBaseURI.
The user parameter is the lookup key used by getLastKimera.

normalization_plan.reason: The _amber parameter exists only to feed setAmberToken's assignment to the amberToken state variable.
The uri parameter exists only to feed setBaseURI's assignment to the baseURI state variable.
The user parameter exists only as the lookup key for the getLastKimera view function.
The local balanceDraGONS is a temporary result of dragons.balanceOf used only by the AKProtocol require check.
The local balanceAmberToken is a temporary result of amberToken.balanceOf used only by the AKProtocol require check.
The local time is a temporary copy of block.timestamp used only inside AKProtocol's cooldown logic.
The local timerUser is a temporary copy of lastKimera[msg.sender] used only inside AKProtocol's cooldown logic.
The local mintIndex is the token id returned by nextToken and consumed by _safeMint inside AKProtocol.
